It only added an acceptance test, updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and created `.lore/dod.md`. Because the production code still gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error`, the newly added test will fail immediately. Furthermore, the candidate omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left a `require-yield` ESLint error in the new test's `rejectingProvider` generator.
